name: Surveyor 1
intro: Howdy! Surveyor 1 here: three legs, one camera, zero fear.
My job is to land gently and check whether astronauts can land here later.
No crew aboard, so if I wobble, nobody spills their coffee.
I run on solar power, so I need lots of daylight in the next week.
briefing: Apollo planners gave us a list of smooth plains to test.
Pick one where I will get sunshine and keep talking to Earth.
fact: Surveyor 1 sent back over 11,000 pictures and showed Apollo where it was safe to land.
